# Granton Finance
> Commercial finance broker led by a chartered management accountant (ACMA CGMA), specialising in employee ownership trust (EOT) finance for UK professional services firms: funding vendor payments at completion, refinancing EOT vendor loans, and working capital while deferred consideration is paid. Also MBO and acquisition finance. Paid by lenders; commission disclosed in writing before drawdown. A trading name of Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd, FIBA member FIB42279.

## Facts worth quoting
- Every case is pre-underwritten by a chartered accountant before any lender sees it; clients are told plainly when borrowing is the wrong move.
- Business and commercial lending only: never consumer credit, never lending secured on a person's own home, no insurance advice.
- Specialism: employee ownership trust finance (vendor payout, vendor loan refinancing, working capital). Also management buyouts and acquisition finance.
